description: A classic table lamp with a conical lampshade and an ornate base. The lampshade is a clean white, tapering slightly towards the top. The base features a sculpted design with a round pedestal, decorative floral-like elements, and a tall, slender stem composed of stacked spheres and a fluted section. Two elegant, curved arms extend from just below the lampshade, creating a decorative silhouette. The entire lamp appears to be made of a single material, likely metal or a composite, given its uniform color and sculpted form. The design evokes a sense of traditional elegance.
